definitions.explanation: Garments worn on the body. A general term for articles of clothing.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{服|ふく}を{買|か}いました。
この{服|ふく}は{高|たか}いです。
{服|ふく}を{着替|きが}えてください。
{朝|あさ}、どんな{服|ふく}を{着|き}ていくか{決|き}めるのに{時間|じかん}がかかります。
examples.english: In the morning, it takes time to decide what clothes to wear.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}の{服|ふく}は{汚|よご}れやすいし、すぐに{小|ちい}さくなるので、{毎年|まいとし}{新|あたら}しいのを{買|か}わなければなりません。
examples.english: Children's clothes get dirty easily and they outgrow them quickly, so we have to buy new ones every year.

notes:
{服|ふく} is the general term for clothing, referring to garments worn on the body.

TYPES OF CLOTHING:
- {洋服|ようふく}: Western-style clothes
- {和服|わふく}: Japanese-style clothes (kimono)
- {制服|せいふく}: uniform
- {私服|しふく}: casual clothes, plain clothes

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {服|ふく}を{着|き}る: to put on/wear clothes
- {服|ふく}を{脱|ぬ}ぐ: to take off clothes
- {服|ふく}を{着替|きが}える: to change clothes
- {服|ふく}を{選|えら}ぶ: to choose clothes

COUNTERS:
- {着|ちゃく}: for suits, outfits
- {枚|まい}: for individual flat items (shirts, etc.)

RELATED WORDS:
- {衣類|いるい}: clothing (formal term)
- {衣服|いふく}: clothes (formal/written)
